verdict.rationale: Docs directly specify the SKILL.md format (a directory with SKILL.md requiring `name` and `description`, plus optional scripts/references) and describe an assisted skill-creator flow that asks what the skill does and when it triggers, reducing the need to reverse-engineer existing skills — this is a documented, structured path to authoring new skills. Missing for 10: a concrete example SKILL.md snippet showing exact frontmatter syntax, and independent/community confirmation that the documented format is sufficient without inspecting existing skills.
